notes: This datafile contains time stamped detections of large mammal species. Detections are based on a year-long camera trap study carried out in Lake Manyara National Park. This file contains only independent detections; we set the threshold for independence of consecutive camera trap pictures to 30min. Time of detection is given as radians. "Category" denotes whether the detection occured during nightime (after sunset and before sunrise) or daytime (after sunrise and before sunset). Sunrise and and sunset times are based on the 15th of each month. For scientific names, body mass and other species-specific variables, please refer to Table 1 of the main manuscript.
